_comment: What each thing that fights back is like, read by Enemy2D by its `kind`.
hp: blows to bring it down, counted in config/weapons.json damage (a Dilim sword does 1).
speed: px/s chasing -- every one is slower than the apo's 260, so she can always run.
windup: seconds of telegraph (the amber glint) before a strike can land. Never under 0.4.
attack_range: how close it must be to start a windup (horizontal for walkers, any way for
fliers). attack_time: how long the strike lasts. lunge: its speed during the strike.
recover: seconds it stands open after a strike. sight: how close she must be for it to
notice her at all. size: the body in px. knock: what its strike does to her, px/s away and up.
flies: true for a flier (no gravity, a locked-line dive). leash: how far along the ground
from where it waits it follows her, px (absent: as far as it sees) -- past it, it goes back.
The far side: the tiyanak keeps to its cry (sight is how close she must come); the
bungisngis's strike is a slam all round it (Bungisngis2D.SLAM_RADIUS), not a lunge; the
manananggal's upper half is DRIVEN OFF at 0, not killed, and its lower half never moves --
only salt or light ends it.
